div.b:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like packing for a trip - you can fit more by: rolling clothes (checkpointing), packing in stages (batch reduction), using smaller items (quantization), or bringing less stuff (shorter sequences)!
TECHNICAL: Memory = model_weights + activations + gradients + optimizer_state. Optimize each component: checkpoint (activations), accumulate (batch), quantize (weights), truncate (sequence).
